artifact.title: Quick Sort Partition (Lomuto) Visualization
artifact.description: Step-by-step partition of array [6,1,8,4,7,2,5] with pivot=5. Shows comparisons, swaps, and final pivot placement.

steps.description: Initial array. Pivot = 5 (last element). i = -1, j = 0.
Compare arr[0]=6 with pivot=5. 6 > 5, so no swap.
Compare arr[1]=1 with pivot=5. 1 <= 5, so swap arr[0] and arr[1].
Swap arr[0] and arr[1]. i becomes 0.
Compare arr[2]=8 with pivot=5. 8 > 5, so no swap.
Compare arr[3]=4 with pivot=5. 4 <= 5, so swap arr[1] and arr[3].
Swap arr[1] and arr[3]. i becomes 1.
Compare arr[4]=7 with pivot=5. 7 > 5, so no swap.
Compare arr[5]=2 with pivot=5. 2 <= 5, so swap arr[2] and arr[5].
Swap arr[2] and arr[5]. i becomes 2.
Swap arr[i+1]=arr[3] with pivot arr[6]. Pivot 5 is now in its final position.
Partition complete. All elements left of pivot (index 3) are ≤5, all elements right are >5.
